The US struck Iranian air-defence sites on Qeshm and Hengam islands on 2 November, AP reports; on 4 November Iran's Guard said four tankers hit mines south of Hormuz, naming no ships.
Democrats won both chambers of Congress; Trump said the Iran war and petrol prices played a part but that he did the right thing.
Iran says it could reopen Hormuz in two days if the US meets its conditions; Qatar is working on an interim deal and says proposals are being exchanged.
Russia fired 59 cruise and 17 ballistic missiles and 289 drones at Ukraine's energy system on 3 November, its largest such attack this year; Kyiv lost power and water.
The US will mediate Ukraine-Russia talks in Abu Dhabi on 10 and 11 November; Lavrov rejected Ukraine's ceasefire proposals the same day.
A Russian strike on a school used as an aid point in Zaporizhzhia region killed at least 31 people on 2 November, regional officials say.
Houthi forces are within about 80 km of Aden after taking a district in Lahij, Reuters reports, citing military sources.
Poland deployed counter-terrorism police near the Kaliningrad border after Tusk said intelligence warned of sabotage in early November; North Korea fired several missiles on 4 November.
